messages:
Alex: quick follow-up from the INCIDENT-2026-115 postmortem — we saw repeated pager storms driven by KV-cache warmup + noisy rate thresholds. need to lock down owners + timelines for remediation (dedupe, thresholds, exporter backoff, paging policy).
Nina: I'll take dedupe + threshold tuning. plan: add probabilistic dedupe for identical alerts, bump threshold for transient spikes, run canary for 48h. target: PR + test by Fri EOD.
Sam: I can handle exporter-side backoff to smooth spike bursts. i need a 4-hour test window on staging (low traffic) and then a 2h prod canary. aiming for PR by Thu.
Lee: I'll review paging policy — propose setting a 10min suppress window for identical signatures and move lower-severity matches to pager->ticket transition. can have a draft policy doc tomorrow.
pagerduty-bot: Created ticket INFR-5423 assigned to @Nina for dedupe rules. Created ticket INFR-5424 assigned to @Sam for exporter backoff.
Nina: action items (short):
- INFR-5423: implement probabilistic dedupe and threshold bump (owner: Nina)
- INFR-5424: exporter backoff + throttling (owner: Sam)
- DOC-179: paging suppression + severity mapping (owner: Lee)
I'll add estimated rollout dates to each ticket.
Sam: quick snippet for throttling I'm planning:
```yaml
exporter:
  burst_limit: 2000
  backoff:
    base_ms: 250
    max_ms: 5000
    jitter: true
```
Sam: We'll also add a short-lived metric to measure suppressed alerts to avoid hiding real incidents.
Alex: thanks — please add test plans to the tickets and link any canary logs. also flag any alerts that should stay paged (eg: auth-service high error percentage).
Lee: scheduling note: weekly follow-up on Wed 10:00am for two weeks to check wave results and decide permanent rule set.
Nina: FYI I'll run a filter sweep to find other alerts with similar signatures and add them to INFR-5423 as subitems. :mag:
Alex: perfect. i'll update the postmortem with owners + deadlines and close the loop in the incident doc. ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
